description.p: ZCode is an AI coding agent from Z.AI. This Flatpak wraps the official Linux desktop build; the app itself is downloaded directly from Z.AI's own distribution servers at install time and is not redistributed by this packaging.

ZCode's built-in terminal runs inside the Flatpak sandbox and only sees the programs the runtime provides, so git, node and compilers are not available to it. Use Z.AI's own AppImage or .deb if you need the agent to drive a full toolchain.
